title: The first emails everyone gets (confirm, magic link, reset) live in the repo where they can be reviewed

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: there is no supabase/templates folder and the auth email template blocks in supabase/config.toml:241-250 are commented out, so the confirm, magic-link and password-reset emails exist only in the Supabase dashboard (RUNBOOKS lists them among settings a migration does not carry). The first email every person gets cannot be reviewed for voice, sender or the brand rules. Fix: check the live templates into supabase/templates and point config.toml at them; dashboard stays the deploy step.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
